title: The Escarpment of the Empty Quarter
author: Ivo Fairweather
blurb: August Ashgrove, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
